title: [ML] Register the named X-content parser for snapshot upgrade params

timeline.message:
[ML] Register the named X-content parser for snapshot upgrade params

Model snapshot upgrade persistent task params may need to be parsed
from X-content if a node is shut down while a model snapshot upgrade
is in progress.

Previously the X-content parser for model snapshot upgrade persistent
task params existed but was not registered. This PR corrects that
omission.

Fixes #84419
timeline.author: David Roberts

timeline.body:
I thought the place to do this was now `MachineLearning`? XPackClientPlugin is just for the transport client that is being removed no?

The fact that we do named writeables vs named xcontent in two different places is confusing.

reply.body: Regardless, approving the PR as it fixes the issue.

> I thought the place to do this was now `MachineLearning`?

All the other ML named x-contents related to persistent tasks were still in `XPackClientPlugin` - 3 for params and 4 for state - so this one is just adding the missing 4th one for params to the same place as the others.  Even if we decide to move all the ML ones into `MachineLearning` it will be better to do this as a separate PR rather than have one PR that moves everything and also adds a missing one.  The addition of the missing one would be disguised by the bulk move.

> The fact that we do named writeables vs named xcontent in two different places is confusing.

Yes, I don't know why #53757 moved the named writables but not the corresponding named x-contents.  The discrepancy in where they're registered is now a likely source of future bugs.

timeline.body:
It turns out this change isn't necessary in the 7.17 branch - the extra bits were added in the 4th commit of #65010.

On backporting this PR I found that the only substantial change was the addition of the unit tests.

Therefore, I'll remove the 7.17.2 label from this PR and remove the release notes from the backport to 7.17, but still backport it to that branch just to get the unit tests.  But there is no user visible change in 7.17 as a result of this fix.
